title: Pika: The Tiny Mountain Bandit | Natural Born Rebels | BBC Earth

segments.description: Medium close-up shot of a small American pika perched among rocky mountain boulders, introducing the alpine wildlife subject.
Wide landscape shot of a sunny alpine slope covered in vibrant wildflowers and rocky scree during the short summer season.
Medium action shot of a pika darting swiftly across the rocks carrying flowers in its mouth while a small predator watches nearby.
Medium tracking shot of mountain sheep grazing on a high-altitude slope, establishing the harsh alpine environment.
Close-up shot of a pika looking out from its rocky crevice home, highlighting its need to prepare for winter hibernation.
Wide panning shot from the rocky mountain peak down to the lush green valley far below where vegetation grows.
Medium close-up shot of a pika frantically cutting and gathering fresh grass and purple flowers to build its winter food stockpile.
Medium tracking shot of the pika making repeated exhausting journeys back up the steep rock pile to deposit vegetation into its haystack.
Close-up shot of the massive finished haystack tucked securely inside a rocky cavity to sustain the pika through winter.
Medium shot of a neighboring pika beginning to gather food much closer to home, sparking an idea for opportunistic theft.
Medium action shot of the pika sneaking over and brazenly stealing freshly cut grass from another pika's stockpile.
Close-up shot of the bandit pika getting caught red-handed and chirping defensively before fleeing with stolen flowers.
Medium tracking shot of the pika dashing back through the rocky labyrinth to successfully escape with its stolen bounty.
Wide scenic landscape shot of the alpine mountain range concluding the wildlife documentary segment.
